annotations.title: Explain This Ladder — why The Ladder reads one NFL market the way it does

description: Why PredictionMarketsPicks' Ladder reads one NFL strike ladder the way it does — a game's spread, a team's season win total, or a player's prop: the read (SHAPE, LOCATION, PRICED, MARKET READ or QB HOLD) in words — which way our curve leans, or whether it is tighter or wider than Kalshi's and where they cross — where Kalshi's ladder centres beside our projection, the widest published gap, and every listed strike with Kalshi's price and our number where we publish one (30–70% only). One ladder per call. Use for "explain the Chiefs win total ladder", "why does the ladder lean Browns", "what does SHAPE mean on <player> receptions".

family.description: Ladder family. Omit to take the team's spread first. One of: spread · season_wins · props.

player.description: Player name, full or partial — his prop ladder.

stat.description: Prop stat for a player, e.g. "receptions" or "rec_yds". Defaults to his widest ladder.

team.description: Team code or nickname (KC, Chiefs) — its game spread ladder, or its season-win ladder with family "season_wins".
